description: This file defines the 'SurveyResponses' class, which models survey response data within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for survey response attributes, methods for saving responses, sending email notifications based on responses, and creating follow-up cases for dissatisfied responses.

classes.name: SurveyResponses
classes.description: Represents survey response data and handles operations like saving responses, sending email notifications, and creating follow-up cases based on survey outcomes.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates if the object implements certain interfaces, specifically the ACL interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey response; if applicable, sends confirmation emails and creates follow-up cases for negative responses.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Prepares and sends an email using a specified template to the contact associated with the survey response.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates email template placeholders with contact and case details.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs the email sent as an email record in the system.
